Main Case No. Crl.P.No.13514 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Office
 Date Order
Sri Gundala Siva Prasad Reddy, learned

counsel for the Petitioner(s) would submit that,
 initially a case in Crime No.159 of 2022 for the  offence under Section 420 IPC was registered  against the Petitioner and in that regard five  cheques have been taken from the Petitioner and  this is the fifth complaint.
It is further submitted  that, in all the four cases, there is an interim  order in favour of the Petitioner.
It is further  submitted that the very same order may be  passed in this matter also.

Considering the submissions, let there be  stay of all further proceedings in C.C.No.318 of  2024 on the file of Judicial First Class Magistrate,
 Prohibition & Excise Court, Kurnool.

sentences.text: _ _ _ _  Dr.VJP, J  Crl.P.No.13514 of 2025  Registry is directed to list the matter along  with Crl.P.Nos.2688, 2692, 4979 and 8214 of  2024 as a batch on 23.01.2026.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner(s) is  permitted to take out personal notice and serve  the same on the counsel for Respondent No.2 before the trial Court and file a memo to that effect.
